strategy.title: No plan: brokered localisation loses money on every deal
strategy.why: The only opening has five written acceptances at $2,000 each ($10,000 reach), but the subcontractor's quoted direct cost is $2,300 per deal, above the $2,000 price, so every deal loses $300 and no settled cash can be accumulated toward the $8,000 target.

alternatives.title: Deliver the five accepted deals anyway
alternatives.why: Collects $10,000 gross but pays $11,500 to Polyglot Freelance Collective: net -$1,500, and with no up-front capital the shortfall cannot be funded.

steps.label: Obtain a fulfilment quote below $2,000 per deal (renegotiate Polyglot or find another localisation subcontractor) or reprice the accepted deals above cost

noPlan.decisiveGap: ECONOMICS: direct cost $2,300 per deal is at or above the $2,000 price, so every deal loses money.
noPlan.resolution: Get a fulfilment quote under $2,000 per deal (renegotiate with Polyglot Freelance Collective or source another subcontractor), or reprice the offer above $2,300 with the accepting studios, then re-plan.

excluded.why: Direct cost $2,300 exceeds price $2,000; each deal loses $300.
